nodes.natural_language: Simplify the following expression to a simplified fraction: $$\sqrt{\dfrac{\dfrac{5}{\sqrt{80}}+\dfrac{\sqrt{845}}{9}+\sqrt{45}}{\sqrt5}}.$$ Show that it is \frac{13}{6}.
